metadata.title: Soulful Motion Portrait with Psychedelic Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, motion-blurred portrait featuring a central figure in a red beanie, framed by vibrant, bulbous red psychedelic typography on a dark, atmospheric background.
triggerTerms: motion blur portrait with red beanie
excludeWhen: minimalist modern sans-serif typography is requested
bright daylight outdoor settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-light, warm-toned photograph of a man in a red beanie and dark jacket, captured with significant motion blur that creates a sense of dynamic movement. The composition is anchored by heavy, rounded, vibrant red display type that follows a vertical stack on the left and a horizontal line at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant red of the beanie matches the saturation of the display typography.
The motion blur of the figure contrasts with the sharp, solid edges of the graphic text.
Warm amber highlights on the clothing bridge the gap between the dark background and the bright red elements.
The vertical text stack creates a structural frame for the fluid, moving subject.
coreInvariants: High-saturation red for all typographic elements and the headwear.
Significant directional motion blur on the central figure.
Dark, underexposed background with warm, localized lighting.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the middle and right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium-close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red beanie serves as the primary focal point, supported by the large-scale red text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves down the vertical stack, then follows the motion blur of the figure toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the background provide negative space that allows the red elements to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant, high-chroma red used for text and the beanie.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and golden yellow highlights on the figure's skin and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, low-value background and the high-saturation, high-value red accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and primary red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, bulbous, psychedelic display face with circular motifs.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely heavy weight with minimal counters
Stylized, almost liquid-like connections between strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a deep, rounded hook
The 'E' consists of three horizontal rounded bars connected by a thick vertical

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over the dark background areas

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage with varying layout orientations (horizontal vs vertical).
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo box in the bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, psychedelic 70s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric roundness and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-light photograph of a man with a red beanie and dark jacket, using a slow shutter speed to create significant motion blur against a dark, warm-toned interior background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay large, ultra-bold, bulbous red display text. Place one line horizontally at the top and the remaining words stacked vertically along the left edge.

verificationChecks: Is the text a vibrant, solid red?
Is the figure noticeably blurred by motion?
Is the font style bulbous and psychedelic?
Is the background dark with warm highlights?

adjustableVariables: Specific words in the vertical stack

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and motion blur
avoid: Clean vector look for the image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red of the text and beanie are visually linked.
Check that the motion blur does not obscure the subject's form entirely.
Verify the typography is stacked vertically on the left.
Confirm the absence of any blue or green tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Motion Blurred Portrait] + [Red Beanie Focal Point] + [Bulbous 70s Red Display Type] + [Dark Warm Interior].
